ideas.title: Chisel for Statues
ideas.hook: Every plot starts with a huge raw boulder. Chip it into a statue, put it on display, and visitors pay coins to see it. Better stone and better chisels make statues worth more.
core_loop: Pick a statue blueprint and chip away the glowing marked areas
Polish and paint the finished statue
Place it in your sculpture garden to earn coins per second
Buy rarer stone (marble, obsidian, crystal) and sharper chisels
ideas.twist: Each boulder has a hidden gem core; carve carefully and the gem becomes the statue's eyes and doubles its value.
retention: Statue index for every stone type
ideas.why_now: Paint/create × Stones is the biggest open gap (score 8.93). Stones/rocks is the hottest theme at 2.90× (+1 Stone Skipping 28.7K CCU, Lift Rock For Eggs 14.9K at 16 days) and Paint/create is rising 2.09× (Paint to Get Rich 17.3K). "___ for ___" titles lead at 3.87×.
ideas.differentiator: Mining games destroy rock for loot; here the rock is the product, and how well you carve it sets your income.

ideas.title: Roll for Nests
ideas.hook: A giant board game wraps the map. Roll dice to move along it; every tile you land on drops a nest of eggs, and rare tiles hide golden nests.
core_loop: Roll the dice to move around the board
Collect the nest on the tile you land on
Hatch eggs into pets that add to your dice rolls
Unlock bigger boards with rarer nests
ideas.twist: Land on the same tile as another player and you roll off for their nest.
ideas.why_now: Dice/cards × Eggs is the second-biggest gap (8.85). Dice/cards is rising 2.53× ([🎉UPD 8] Anime Dice 51.7K CCU at 59 days) and eggs are the biggest young theme (Break and Steal an Egg 147.8K, Climb For Animals Eggs 16.2K). The Dice + RNG pair already shows 51.7K young CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Egg games hand you eggs from a shop or a rock; here a board-game roll decides where you land and what you hatch.

ideas.title: Decorate for Eggs
ideas.hook: Paint a blank egg however you like. Other players rate it, and the higher your score, the rarer the pet that hatches out.
core_loop: Grab a blank egg and paint it with brushes and stickers
Submit it to the rating wall for 30 seconds
Hatch it; rarity depends on the score
Spend coins on new paints, patterns and egg sizes
ideas.twist: Theme of the round (spooky, gold, space) gives bonus rarity if your egg matches.
retention: Hall of fame for top-rated eggs
ideas.why_now: Paint/create × Eggs is an open gap (7.31). Paint/create is rising 2.09× ([🥞] Paint a Pancake 6.1K at 20 days, [🎨] Hide In Pixels 3.3K at 18 days) and Coloring & Drawing is up 1.54×. Eggs drive 305.7K young CCU (Break and Steal an Egg 147.8K).
ideas.differentiator: Hatching is pure luck in other egg games; here your own art and player votes decide the pet.

ideas.title: Roll for Riffs
ideas.hook: Roll for band members and instruments of different rarities, then play shows that pay out based on your lineup. A legendary drummer can carry a whole stage.
core_loop: Roll for musicians and instruments
Build a five-slot band lineup
Play a quick rhythm show for fans and coins
Upgrade the stage to unlock bigger venues
ideas.twist: Matching instruments with the right genre gives combo bonuses, so a rare guitarist in a jazz band can be worth less than a common one.
retention: Weekly battle of the bands leaderboard
ideas.why_now: Dice/cards × Music is an open gap (5.82). Dice/cards is up 2.53× ([🎉UPD 8] Anime Dice 51.7K) and Music/dance is rising 1.59× (Piano Rhythm Tiles 5.1K at 26 days, [UPD] Aura Dance Battles 4.5K at 44 days). RNG roll is up 1.46×.
ideas.differentiator: RNG games roll for auras or fighters; here every roll fills a band, and the lineup has to work together on stage.

ideas.title: Lasso for Zombies
ideas.hook: At night, ride out and lasso zombies before they reach your farm. By day, the zombies you caught work your plot, and rare ones work faster.
core_loop: Survive the night by lassoing zombies at your fence
Drag them into pens on your plot
Assign them to jobs that earn coins by day
Upgrade lassos, pens and fences for tougher nights
ideas.twist: Some zombies are mutated (glowing, giant, frozen) and are worth a lot, but they can break out and wreck your plot if your pens are weak.
retention: New biomes with new zombie types
ideas.why_now: Collect/index × Zombies is an open gap (5.28). Collect/index is rising 2.48× (Steal ASMR! 11.1K, Lift Rock For Eggs 14.9K) and zombies are up 1.30× (Build and Kill Zombies 11.2K at 55 days, ✈️ Zombie Air Force 3.7K at 19 days). Survive + Tycoon pairs hold 25.8K young CCU (Bunker vs Verity 16.5K).
ideas.differentiator: Zombie games make you kill the horde; here you catch it, index it and put it to work.

ideas.title: Sculpt Ice for Cash
ideas.hook: You get a block of ice and a timer. Carve the order before it melts under the heat lamps, and get paid by how close your sculpture is to the order.
core_loop: Take an order (swan, car, dragon)
Carve the ice block before it melts
Get paid by accuracy and speed
Buy better tools and colder freezers
ideas.twist: Fire events crank the heat mid-order; finish faster or lose the piece.
ideas.why_now: Paint/create × Ice/fire is an open gap (5.93). Ice/fire is rising 1.85× (Firefighting Sim 11.6K at 21 days, Melt All The Ice! 2.7K at 30 days), Paint/create is up 2.09×, and money themes are rising 2.20× (Paint to Get Rich 17.3K).
ideas.differentiator: Ice games have you melt or smash ice; here you shape it against the clock to fill orders.

ideas.title: Deal for Outfits
ideas.hook: Every outfit piece is a card. Open packs, build a hand of clothes, and walk the runway; judges score the full look and the rarity of the pieces.
core_loop: Open clothing card packs
Build a five-card outfit hand for the round's theme
Walk the runway and get scored
Trade duplicates and unlock rarer packs
ideas.twist: Cards have set bonuses; a full matching set triggers a special runway effect and big points.
ideas.why_now: Dice/cards × Fashion is an open gap (5.76). Fashion is rising 1.39× (Makeup Mania! 5.9K at 18 days, Facecard: Makeup Showdown 4.6K at 8 days) and Dress Up is up 1.26× (🎀 Make Dresses 2.4K). Dice/cards is rising 2.53×.
ideas.differentiator: Dress-up games give you every item; here you collect clothes as cards and play the hand you have.

ideas.title: Paint for Cures
ideas.hook: Zombies are just grey. Spray them back to full colour and they turn human again, paying you as thanks. Bigger hordes, bigger paint cannons.
core_loop: Walk into a grey zombie zone
Spray zombies until they are fully coloured
Collect cash from cured townsfolk
Upgrade paint tanks and spray range to clear new zones
ideas.twist: Some zombies only cure with the right colour, so you swap paint mid-fight.
ideas.why_now: Paint/create × Zombies is an open gap (4.45). Paint/create is rising 2.09× (Paint to Get Rich 17.3K, [🥞] Paint a Pancake 6.1K) and zombies are up 1.30× (Build and Kill Zombies 11.2K). Hub + zones maps are rising 1.66×.
ideas.differentiator: Zombie games are about weapons; here your weapon is paint, and every hit visibly restores the world.

ideas.title: +1 Catapult Power
ideas.hook: Load a rock, fire your catapult at a castle wall and gain +1 power every shot. Break through walls to reach new kingdoms with bigger castles.
core_loop: Fire rocks at the castle wall
Gain +1 power per shot
Smash walls for gold and loot
Rebirth for heavier ammo and new kingdoms
ideas.twist: Each castle has a weak brick; hit it and the whole wall collapses for a bonus.
ideas.why_now: +1 titles are up 1.89× (+1 Stone Skipping 28.7K, +1 Assassin Leveling 8.6K at 19 days). Stones/rocks is the fastest theme at 2.90×, Break/mine leads mechanics at 3.47×, and the Hit/swing + +1 pair holds 28.7K young CCU.
ideas.differentiator: +1 games usually grow your body; here you grow a siege weapon and watch whole castles fall.

ideas.title: Hero Card Tycoon
ideas.hook: Open hero card packs and place your heroes on your city plot. Heroes earn money and guard your base while other players send their own heroes to raid it.
core_loop: Open hero card packs
Place heroes on your plot to earn and defend
Raid other plots with your best heroes
Upgrade your city to hold more heroes
ideas.twist: Heroes level up by being played together; a team of the same power type unlocks a combo shield.
ideas.why_now: Dice/cards × Superheroes is an open gap (4.54). Dice/cards is up 2.53× ([🎉UPD 8] Anime Dice 51.7K), Tycoon/base building is rising 2.13×, and Steal + Tycoon pairs hold 40.5K young CCU. "___ Tycoon" titles are up 1.17× ([🎃] Parcel Tycoon 5.7K at 16 days, Army Commander Tycoon 3.7K at 15 days).
ideas.differentiator: Hero games are fighting arenas; here heroes are collectible cards that run and defend your city.
